pass_at_1.method: share of trials that pass every check; 95% interval from a bootstrap over scenarios

pass_hat_k.method: mean over scenarios with all k runs of C(passes, k) / C(runs, k)

duplicate_writes.method: commits that re-apply a change already committed

unexpected_writes.method: commits beyond the scenario's expected number of writes

false_confirmations.method: heard statements that a change is done, or of a slot, that the record did not show when they were heard (or by the end of the call)

false_failures.method: heard statements that a change failed while the record showed it saved (or that a later write made false)

clarification.method: a clarifying question was answered before the first write

cost.method: tokens at the dated list price (paid tier); a free-tier key is not charged
